scanner_c.notes: Sep 26 Toronto-morning scan using fresh Sep 25-26 reporting. Prioritized market-moving macro/rates, AI infrastructure/semiconductors, major platform strategy, and verified legal/policy catalysts; sources include Bloomberg/Bloomberg Law, TechCrunch, and reputable syndication of Bloomberg reporting.

items.event_title: US Treasury yields around 5% increasingly look like a new market regime
items.news_summary: The 10-year Treasury yield moved above 5.2% and the 30-year yield near 5.4%, levels not seen in roughly two decades, forcing investors to reassess equity valuations, credit costs and duration risk.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for SPY/QQQ, growth equities, credit, housing and all long-duration assets.
items.selection_reason: Fresh market-wide regime story with direct implications for equity multiples and financing costs.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg current homepage/Big Take corroborated by a same-day secondary summary of the Bloomberg story.
items.video_angle: 10年美债站上5%以后，真正危险的不是一天跌多少，而是整个美股估值公式换了。

items.event_title: Oracle force-majeure notice raises new questions for AI data-center debt
items.news_summary: Morgan Stanley said Oracle's force-majeure notice to the developer of a massive New Mexico data center is putting loan and lease documents under fresh scrutiny, especially projects with construction risk or weaker tenants.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for ORCL, data-center developers, private credit, hyperscaler financing and the broader AI infrastructure debt trade.
items.selection_reason: Concrete fresh stress point linking a major AI customer to debt-market underwriting risk.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg News via Bloomberg Law, Sep 25, 20:12 UTC.
items.youtube_query: Oracle ORCL data center debt force majeure
items.video_angle: AI数据中心最大的风险可能不是需求，而是合同和债务：Oracle 一纸 force majeure 为什么让华尔街重新算账？

items.event_title: Meta's Muse AI app passes 3.4 million downloads as promotion accelerates
items.news_summary: Sensor Tower estimates cited by TechCrunch put Muse above 3.4 million downloads, with daily active users rising 27% after Meta Connect; the app remains No.1 in U.S. app stores while Meta expands promotion across its network.
items.investor_materiality: High for META because Muse is becoming a measurable distribution and AI monetization test rather than only a product announcement.
items.selection_reason: Fresh adoption data turns the Muse narrative into a quantifiable platform-distribution story.
items.source_quality_note: TechCrunch Sep 25 citing Sensor Tower, Appfigures and Apptopia estimates.
items.youtube_query: Meta META Muse AI app downloads
items.video_angle: Muse 不是只靠发布会炒热度：3.4百万下载背后，Meta 正把 Facebook/Instagram 的分发优势变成 AI 护城河。

items.event_title: Microsoft folds consumer and work Copilot together, de-emphasizing the personal chatbot race
items.news_summary: Microsoft is merging consumer and workplace Copilot into one product focused on enterprise productivity, coding and agents, effectively ceding more of the standalone personal-chatbot battle to OpenAI, Google and Meta.
items.investor_materiality: High for MSFT and the AI application layer because it sharpens Microsoft's monetization focus around enterprise distribution rather than consumer chatbot share.
items.selection_reason: Clear strategic repositioning by one of the largest AI spenders with implications for Copilot economics and competitive positioning.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg reporting syndicated by Moneycontrol; Bloomberg author page lists the story at Sep 25, 12:00 UTC.
items.youtube_query: Microsoft MSFT Copilot reboot enterprise AI
items.video_angle: Microsoft 为什么不跟 ChatGPT、Gemini、Muse 正面抢个人聊天机器人了？答案可能在企业 AI 的利润率。

items.event_title: Oil falls and stocks rebound on hopes for a phased US-Iran Hormuz deal
items.news_summary: Brent eased toward $104 as reports said Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz and reviving nuclear talks; the S&P 500 rose about 0.5% and bond volatility eased.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for inflation expectations, Fed pricing, energy equities, airlines and the equity risk premium.
items.selection_reason: Fresh geopolitical catalyst directly transmitting through oil, bonds and stocks.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg Markets Wrap syndicated by SWI swissinfo, published Sep 25 22:31.
items.youtube_query: Iran Hormuz oil stocks Treasury September 2026
items.video_angle: 油价一跌、美股就弹：现在市场真正交易的不是战争本身，而是 Hormuz 能不能重新打开。

items.event_title: SK Hynix's Solidigm is said to weigh a US IPO as soon as 2027
items.news_summary: Solidigm, SK Hynix's NAND and enterprise-SSD unit, is reportedly discussing a U.S. IPO that could value the business at as much as $100 billion; it supplies data-center storage including CoreWeave.
items.investor_materiality: High for NAND, enterprise SSD, AI storage, SK Hynix, Micron, SanDisk and data-center supply-chain valuation comps.
items.selection_reason: Large potential U.S. listing creates a new public-market valuation benchmark for AI storage.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg reporting syndicated by Yahoo Japan; article surfaced Sep 26 Japan time and notes Reuters had separately reported bank outreach/timing details.
items.youtube_query: Solidigm SK Hynix IPO AI SSD
items.video_angle: 一个可能1000亿美元的 AI 存储 IPO：Solidigm 会不会把 Micron、SanDisk、NAND 全部重新估值？

items.event_title: Anthropic loses a DC Circuit challenge to US supply-chain risk designation
items.news_summary: A federal appeals court rejected Anthropic's challenge to the administration's supply-chain risk designation, though a separate California ruling that lifted a broader government ban remains in effect.
items.investor_materiality: High for the AI model market, government AI procurement and partners/investors exposed to Anthropic.
items.selection_reason: Fresh legal ruling creates real commercial and government-contract uncertainty for a leading frontier-model company.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg News/Bloomberg Law, updated Sep 25 19:15 UTC with court details and Anthropic response.
items.youtube_query: Anthropic Claude supply chain risk Pentagon court
items.video_angle: Anthropic 为什么会被美国政府贴上 supply-chain risk？这场官司影响的不只是 Claude，而是 AI 公司能不能给政府设使用红线。

items.event_title: Trump-Xi summit ends with limited substantive announcements
items.news_summary: The summit featured extensive diplomacy but anticipated tariff-cut agreements and a new AI communication channel had not been announced; Hong Kong-listed Chinese shares weakened as traders saw limited concrete progress.
items.investor_materiality: High for semiconductors, China-exposed megacaps, tariffs, rare-earth supply chains and cross-border AI policy.
items.selection_reason: The market had priced summit expectations; the absence of major announced breakthroughs is itself a fresh information point.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg News reporting reproduced by BusinessMirror and reflected on Bloomberg's current summit coverage.
items.youtube_query: Trump Xi summit AI tariffs chips September 2026
items.video_angle: 中美元首会晤最大的消息可能是“没消息”：AI、关税都没突破，为什么市场反而要重新定价？

items.event_title: AI-driven nuclear investment surges but new reactors still face long timelines
items.news_summary: U.S. nuclear startups have raised about $4.6 billion in 2026, but regulatory approvals, supply-chain constraints and first-of-a-kind construction risks mean broad commercialization may not arrive until around 2035.
items.investor_materiality: High for AI power demand, utilities, nuclear developers and data-center capex assumptions.
items.selection_reason: Fresh evidence separates nuclear fundraising momentum from the actual timetable for delivering electricity to AI data centers.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg reporting republished by EnergyNow on Sep 25, citing Crunchbase and Bloomberg Intelligence.
items.youtube_query: AI data center nuclear power investment 2026
items.video_angle: AI 缺电让核能融资爆发，但钱到了、电还要等到2030年代：这条产业链最容易被市场高估什么？

items.event_title: DeepMind alumni exodus draws venture capital attention
items.news_summary: Bloomberg reported growing startup formation and fundraising interest among DeepMind employees and alumni as elite AI researchers consider leaving established labs to launch new companies.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high for Alphabet's AI talent moat and the competitive dynamics of frontier-model startups.
items.selection_reason: Fresh talent-flow signal can matter before product-market share shifts become visible in financial results.
items.source_quality_note: Bloomberg News via Bloomberg Law, Sep 25 15:45 UTC.
items.youtube_query: Google DeepMind AI talent startup exodus
items.video_angle: Google AI 真正要防的可能不是 OpenAI，而是自己的人出去创业：DeepMind 人才流失会不会削弱护城河？
